jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Data Platform
jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

A capture is just the beginning. Before that footage becomes a dataset a robotics team can train on, it needs to be uploaded, processed, checked, labeled and packaged. You’ll build the systems that make that happen, along with the tools our operators, researchers and customers rely on every day.

Our Data Platform—internally, the Data Engine—has work for software and machine learning engineers who like understanding how the pieces fit together. You’ll join as a generalist, starting in a pod that matches your strengths and company needs: capture, QA, text labels, delivery or infrastructure and platform. People move between pods as needs change, and you’ll own what you ship.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build across the stack.** You’ll take software from design through production, working across frontend, backend and data systems.
* **Make the tools people need.** You’ll build clear, fast interfaces for the operators, researchers and customers using our platform every day.
* **Keep the data moving.** You’ll scale the systems that ingest, process, store and serve very large volumes of video and sensor data.
* **Make quality part of the pipeline.** You’ll run the systems that check, label and package data, including models working inside those pipelines, and keep bad data from reaching customers.
* **Own how it runs.** You’ll take responsibility for reliability, performance and cost, replacing manual work and one-off scripts with durable systems.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Strong software engineering fundamentals.** You bring sound system design and hands-on experience with Python or TypeScript.
* **Experience beyond a single layer.** You’ve worked across more than one layer of a production stack, or run models inside production pipelines.
* **Good judgment when systems are live.** You’re comfortable monitoring, debugging and fixing production issues.
* **The ability to make sense of ambiguous requirements.** You can work with researchers and non-technical users to turn an unclear need into reliable, usable software.
* **Ownership and speed.** You scope work tightly, ship a useful first version quickly and follow through on what you build.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Capture:** Capture applications and ingestion, device and sensor data, streaming and upload systems.
* **QA:** Automated quality checks, model-based QA, review tools and dashboards.
* **Text labels:** Captioning and annotation pipelines, labeling tools and language-model-assisted labeling.
* **Delivery:** Turning customer specifications into reproducible datasets, release gates, packaging, privacy checks and delivery tracking.
* **Infrastructure and platform:** Databases such as MongoDB and ClickHouse, distributed GPU compute, storage, observability, model serving and training infrastructure.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Computer Vision
jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build models for the problems in front of us.** You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
* **Work through the difficult footage.** You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
* **Find out where your models fail.** You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
* **Own the path to production.** You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
* **Follow problems through to a fix.** You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Strong machine learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
* **Experience training large vision models from scratch.** Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
* **Depth in a computer vision specialty.** You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
* **Experience owning models in production.** You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
* **Comfort with the work as it is.** You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Hand and body tracking:** 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
* **SLAM, VIO and calibration:** Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
* **3D reconstruction and objects:** Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Software Engineer II | Global Intelligence, Data Platform  
  
About the team  
  
Global Intelligence helps Uber understand competitive landscapes and marketplace dynamics across Mobility and Delivery. We partner with scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to transform complex data into trusted insights that inform product, pricing, and marketplace decisions.  
  
Our engineering team builds the data foundations behind these insights: integrating external sources, developing scalable data pipelines and models, and creating reusable platform capabilities. We leverage AI to accelerate data integration, improve data understanding, and make our platform easier to operate and use.  
  
About the role  
  
We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent data systems for Global Intelligence. You will take ownership of data platform capabilities from problem definition and technical design through implementation and production operations. Working with engineers, scientists, and product, you’ll navigate incomplete requirements, resolve ambiguity, and translate business and analytical needs into maintainable engineering solutions.  
  
This role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on data engineering. You’ll build ETL/ELT pipelines, design data models and contracts, strengthen data quality, and apply AI to meaningfully improve our workflows and products.  
  
What you’ll do  

* **Drive problems from discovery to production.** Work with stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify dependencies, evaluate alternatives, and deliver solutions with measurable impact.
* **Design and build ETL/ELT systems.** Develop scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines that integrate heterogeneous external and internal data sources, supporting incremental processing, orchestration, backfills, and recovery.
* **Develop durable data models.** Define dataset grain, keys, relationships, and historical behavior, build reusable models that support analytical, scientific, and downstream product needs.
* **Establish data contracts.** Define and maintain expectations for schemas, semantics, freshness, completeness, and compatibility. Manage schema evolution and changes across producers and consumers.
* **Build quality into the platform.** Implement validation, reconciliation, automated testing, and observability to detect missing, duplicated, delayed, or inconsistent data before it affects downstream decisions.
* **Apply system-design judgment.** Make thoughtful tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, reliability, latency, cost, and maintainability. Reuse existing infrastructure and develop shared abstractions where appropriate.
* **Build with and for AI.** Identify and evaluate opportunities to use AI for workflows such as schema mapping, data extraction, quality investigation, and developer productivity. Build the validation, evaluation, and safeguards needed to make these capabilities dependable.
* **Own production outcomes.** Monitor pipeline health and data reliability, troubleshoot incidents, address root causes, and improve operational tooling and documentation.
* **Collaborate and raise engineering quality.** Contribute to code reviews and design discussions, share knowledge, and improve the maintainability and usability of the systems you support.

  
Basic qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **3+ years of professional software engineering or data engineering experience**, including building and operating production data systems.
* Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language such as Python, Java, Go, or C++, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience designing and developing ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Experience with data modeling, including defining dataset grain, keys, relationships, and approaches to incremental and historical data processing.
* Experience designing data-intensive systems and explaining tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience implementing data-quality checks, automated tests, monitoring, and schema or interface contracts.
* Experience with distributed data-processing frameworks and workflow orchestration systems.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, break down problems, and independently drive delivery while collaborating across dependencies.

  
Preferred qualifications  

* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or comparable processing and orchestration technologies.
* Experience integrating external datasets or APIs with evolving schemas and varying data quality.
* Experience building reusable data-platform tooling, metadata-driven pipelines, or self-service capabilities.
* Hands-on experience applying LLMs or other AI techniques to data workflows, including evaluation, structured-output validation, and human-review mechanisms.
* Experience preparing trusted datasets for machine learning, AI applications, or statistical modeling.
* Familiarity with data lineage, privacy, access controls, and governance.
* Experience partnering with scientists and analysts to translate exploratory workflows into reliable production systems.

  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Fintech

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/  
  
About Us:  
  
Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.  
  
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.  
  
About the Role  
Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build agentic AI systems on AWS that power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design and ship MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Bedrock-based agents, and Claude-powered workflows, and own the AWS-native infrastructure behind them end-to-end (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, CDK).  
  
You'll work at the intersection of modern AI tooling and production cloud engineering, connecting AI agents to enterprise systems and data, automating manual operational work, and turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, secure, observable services. The business problems are well understood; how you solve them with AWS + AI is up to you. We're looking for an engineer who stays current with the AI tooling landscape (models, agent frameworks, coding assistants, MCP), uses these tools heavily every day, and raises the bar on automation for the whole team.  
  
You Will:  
Build agentic AI systems  
  
Build MCP servers that give AI agents and assistants (Claude, Amazon Q, Kiro, and internal tools) secure access to enterprise data and actions, including through Bedrock AgentCore Gateway  
Build Bedrock agents and Claude-powered workflows (using AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Strands Agents, or LangGraph) that automate Finance work like reconciliations, reporting, variance analysis, and payouts  
Evaluate and adopt new AI tools, models, and patterns as they emerge; turn prototypes into production-grade services  
Design for safety and trust through prompt/tool design, guardrails, human-in-the-loop approvals, evaluation, and auditability  
  
Build on AWS  
  
Build and run the AWS services that host the agents and integrations (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, ECS/Fargate)  
Manage infrastructure with CDK, including CI/CD, IAM, VPC connectivity, secrets management, and beta/gamma/prod environments  
Develop data pipelines between enterprise apps, Redshift, and S3, and make that data available to AI agents  
Set up monitoring for agents and services (CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, tracing)  
  
Cross-cutting  
  
Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions  
Own production systems end-to-end, from deployment and monitoring to incident response and iterative improvement  
Raise the team's bar through code reviews, docs, mentoring, and promoting AI-assisted development  
  
Perks  

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

  
About the team  
Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build the systems where SAP meets AWS — extending our enterprise ERP with cloud-native services and agentic AI to power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll work on SAP-side development (ABAP, CDS, RAP, OData) and AWS-native engineering (Lambda, Step Functions, MCP servers, Bedrock, CDK) — owning integrations end-to-end.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience writing, deploying, and reviewing infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) in a team setting
* Experience designing, testing, and debugging APIs (REST, JSON, OpenAPI) using tools like Bruno or Postman, including building request collections, handling authentication flows, and validating response contracts
* Understanding of OAuth 2.0 authorization flows (authorization code, client credentials) and OpenID Connect (OIDC) for securing APIs and agent-to-service access

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer, DevOps Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or AI Practitioner)

jobs.title: Robotics Research Engineer (VLA Engineer)
jobs.description:
**About Trener**

Trener is a Physical AI company building software-defined robotics for industrial automation. Our platform is built on the ROS 2 ecosystem, and our product, Acteris, is running in production with real customers on real factory floors — not in a demo lab.

Backed by a $32M Series A, we operate from dual headquarters in San Jose, California and Trondheim, Norway, with teammates across six countries. We work by four values: Move Fast Together, Earn Customer Champions, Deliver with Excellence, and Challenge the Possible.  
  
**The role**

You will turn VLA research into robot behavior that works on a production line. Industrial work cells are high-mix and unforgiving: parts vary, lighting changes, and a policy that succeeds 80% of the time in simulation is not a product.

As a Robotics Research Engineer in T-Labs, you will own the full loop — data, training, evaluation, and on-robot deployment — for foundation-model-based manipulation policies. You will work alongside our AI compute, perception, and integration engineers to move models from paper to pilot to customer deployment.  
  
**What you’ll do**

* Design, train, and fine-tune Vision-Language-Action models for industrial manipulation tasks such as pick-and-place, kitting, machine tending, and assembly.
* Build and scale robot learning data pipelines: teleoperation and demonstration collection, data curation, augmentation, and synthetic data from simulation.
* Adapt pretrained vision-language backbones to robot action spaces, including action tokenization, diffusion or flow-matching action heads, and multi-camera inputs.
* Define evaluation protocols and benchmarks that measure real-world success rate, robustness, and generalization to new parts, cells, and instructions.
* Close the sim-to-real gap using simulation environments (Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or Gazebo) and domain randomization.
* Deploy policies on physical robots through ROS 2, working with the AI Compute team to meet latency and memory targets on edge hardware (quantization, distillation, TensorRT).
* Track and reproduce state-of-the-art research, and share findings through internal tech talks, write-ups, and — where appropriate — publications at venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, and IROS.
* Partner with Product, Integration, and customer-facing teams to turn customer use cases into learnable tasks and measurable milestones.

**What you’ll bring**

* MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent industry experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in robot learning, imitation learning, or reinforcement learning applied to manipulation.
* Direct experience training or fine-tuning large multimodal models (VLMs, VLAs, or transformer-based policies) in PyTorch or JAX.
* Strong Python skills and working proficiency in C++.
* Experience running learned policies on physical robot hardware, not only in simulation.
* Familiarity with ROS or ROS 2.
* Comfort with distributed GPU training and experiment tracking (e.g., Weights & Biases, MLflow).
* A track record of shipping research into working systems, and clear communication across research and engineering teams.

**Nice to have**

* Publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or CVPR on robot learning or embodied AI.
* Contributions to open-source robot learning projects.
* Experience with diffusion policies, flow matching, or world models for control.
* Hands-on work with industrial arms (e.g., UR, ABB, KUKA, FANUC) and grippers, force/torque sensing, or tactile sensing.
* Experience optimizing models for edge inference (quantization, pruning, distillation, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson).
* Background in large-scale teleoperation or data collection infrastructure.
* Experience at a robotics startup or in a production manufacturing environment.

jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

Every capture tells a story: what someone did, when they did it and whether they completed the task. At Mecka, you’ll build vision-language and video models that turn that footage into useful annotations and catch quality issues across more video than a human team could review.

You’ll own the work from data selection and training through evaluation and production. We’re looking for someone who brings strong research instincts and the engineering skills to make models reliable at scale—and who wants to understand where they fail as much as where they succeed.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build models that understand the footage.** You’ll develop and improve vision-language and video models for egocentric and manipulation footage.
* **Catch problems across what we collect.** You’ll build model pipelines that identify capture defects, missing coverage and task errors, then check their performance against human audits.
* **Make models more reliable.** You’ll use supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve reliability and reasoning.
* **Turn video into useful annotations.** You’ll build pipelines for captioning, temporal grounding and video annotation at scale.
* **Take experiments through to production.** You’ll run large experiments on distributed GPU infrastructure, analyze the results and turn successful approaches into production systems.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Hands-on experience with large multimodal models.** You’ve trained, fine-tuned or post-trained vision-language or multimodal models.
* **Strong deep learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with PyTorch or JAX.
* **Experience running large experiments.** You can design an experiment, see it through and draw sound conclusions from the results.
* **Familiarity with distributed training.** You know your way around GPU-based development and distributed training infrastructure.
* **Research instincts and engineering discipline.** You ask good questions, test your assumptions and build clean systems that hold up beyond the experiment.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Footage quality control:** Using vision-language and video models to identify defects and gaps in captured data.
* **Video understanding and annotation:** Structured captioning, temporal grounding and scene understanding.
* **Training and post-training:** Reward modeling, synthetic data, and data curation and filtering for multimodal models.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - GPU Inference Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

San Francisco

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Research & Engineering

Overview

**Role:** Member of Technical Staff - GPU Inference Engineer
  
**Team:** Research & Engineering
  
**Location:** San Francisco; Boston; Remote
  
**Location Type:** Hybrid
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Liquid AI**
-------------------

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

GPU inference sits underneath much of how we build and ship models at Liquid. Evaluation runs, synthetic data generation, and our API service all depend on how fast and how cheaply we can serve Liquid Foundation Models on GPUs, and demand for that work is growing. You will join the small team that owns our GPU serving stack, built on vLLM and SGLang, and make it faster and cheaper to run.

This is a high-ownership role: you will be pointed at whichever inference bottleneck matters most and carry it from profiling to a benchmarked result. The work sits at the serving-framework level rather than in custom CUDA kernels, which is a separate role on the team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We need someone who:

* **Reasons from first principles:** Explains why a workload is slow before changing it, working from what the model and the GPU are actually doing rather than from framework defaults.
* **Picks up the next problem and owns it:** Moves from evaluation throughput to data generation to API serving as priorities shift, and takes each one through to a measured result.
* **Makes other teams faster:** Works directly with the researchers and engineers who depend on inference, and treats their throughput as the result that counts.

**The Work**
------------

* Own and improve our GPU serving stack on vLLM and SGLang, from configuration and scheduling choices to changes in the frameworks themselves
* Speed up large-scale evaluation and synthetic data generation, and design the inference pipelines those workloads run on
* Select, profile, and benchmark the inference engine behind our API service, and adapt the API layer around it
* Integrate Liquid Foundation Models into vLLM, SGLang, and Hugging Face Transformers, and maintain those public integrations as models and frameworks change
* Diagnose throughput and latency problems alongside the researchers and serving engineers who hit them

**Experience & Capabilities**
-----------------------------

**What you'll need:**

* Hands-on experience running LLM inference on GPUs with a serving framework such as vLLM or SGLang, beyond default configuration
* First-principles understanding of LLM inference: the transformer forward pass, autoregressive decoding on a GPU, and the latency, throughput, and memory trade-offs that follow
* Solid grasp of GPU fundamentals as they bear on inference. You do not need to have written CUDA kernels
* Experience profiling and benchmarking inference workloads and acting on what the numbers show
* Strong Python and PyTorch, and comfort reading and changing large open-source codebases

**Helpful, not required:**

* Merged contributions to vLLM, SGLang, or FlashInfer
* Lower-level GPU optimization experience, such as CUDA or Triton kernels
* Experience building high-throughput batch inference for evaluation or synthetic data generation

**What Success Looks Like (Year One)**
--------------------------------------

* Evaluation and synthetic data generation run measurably faster and at lower cost per token on the same hardware, freeing GPU capacity for other work
* The inference engine and configuration behind our API service are chosen on benchmark evidence, and have been profiled and tuned for latency and throughput
* Liquid models run correctly and efficiently in the public serving frameworks and libraries our users rely on, including vLLM, SGLang, and Transformers

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Problems standard stacks don't solve:** Our hybrid architectures do not drop into off-the-shelf serving frameworks unchanged, and the inference you speed up feeds how every Liquid model is evaluated and trained. High ownership from day one. [INFERRED - review this line]
* **Compensation & Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.
* **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.
* **Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.
* **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.description:
Foundations - San Francisco

  

### **About the Team**

The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science.

The Search team sits within Foundationsation. In close partnership with researchers, we bring modeling advances into production and improve how AI systems discover, retrieve, and use knowledge.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Researcher to lead our safety and alignment research: building the systems that distinguish useful web content from spam, manipulation, and other adversarial or low-quality material.

The challenge extends beyond evaluating individual pages. A page may appear credible in isolations, metadata, or relationships with other sites reveal coordinated manipulation. As AI makes convincing content easier to produce at scale, detection systems must adapt to increasingly sophisticated adversaries.

You’ll define the technical approach, build classifiers and evaluations, and shape how integrity signals influence what Search indexes and retrieves. Working closely with Search and broader Safety and Integrity teams, you’ll use frontier models to advance detection methods and bring them into production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define the technical direction for Safety + Integrity, identifying gaps and determining which problems and interventions to prioritize.
* Develop AI and ML systems to detect spam, scams, phishing, malicious domains, prompt injections, and other adversarial or low-quality web content.
* Discover useful signals across page contents, domains, metadata, and relationships between websites, including patterns that reveal coordinated manipulation.
* Build evaluations that measure detection quality and how integrity interventions affect the information Search surfaces.
* Translate detection signals into indexing, ranking, and filtering decisions, improving what models can retrieve and rely on.
* Serve as the technical owner for integrity within Search, partnering with researchers, engineers, and broader Safety and Integrity teams to build and deploy these systems.

### **You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have**

* Deep experience in web spam, search quality, adversarial content detection, or related integrity problems at scale.
* Strong applied ML and research skills, with experience developing classifiers, detection methods, and evaluations for real-world systems.
* An understanding of how adversaries manipulate content and links, coordinate across sites, and adapt to detection systems.
* A track record of independently defining ambiguous technical problems and driving solutions from experimentation through production.
* Experience working across research, engineering, and integrity teams while remaining hands-on with technical work.
* A first-principles approach to using frontier models and compute, and a strong interest in keeping detection systems effective as adversaries evolve.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Vercel started as the home for frontends. This past year we took Python on Vercel to general availability, launched Vercel Services so frontends and backends deploy together as one project, and, alongside our Compute team, helped bring always-on background workers to the platform.

Next, we’re bringing first-class support to Go and Rust, from builds and packaging to runtime integration and SDKs, and improving observability so developers can see how their services connect and where requests spend their time. The Platform IoT team runs the device cloud that keeps Motive devices connected. We own the full path between devices and the cloud, including provisioning and identity, messaging, firmware updates and certificates, configuration delivery, data ingestion, and monitoring. As a Software Engineer on the team, you'll build and monitor the services behind these systems and own projects end-to-end—from design and well-tested code to safe deployment and production operations. You'll work with backend, firmware, and product engineers to solve the challenges of keeping a large fleet secure, up to date, and reporting data. Our client is a fast-growing healthcare AI startup that achieved **30x revenue growth over the past year**.

The company develops and deploys AI agents directly within leading healthcare systems, working with organizations such as Mayo Clinic and Cleveland Clinic to improve clinical workflows and operational efficiency.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field.
* Availability to work on-site in San Francisco.

**Early-Career Engineers (1–2 Years of Experience)**

==================

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

**About the Role**
------------------

Cartesia builds real-time multimodal intelligence: fast, state-of-the-art voice models and the products that make them useful. We started as a research lab, pioneered the state space model architecture, and now we're bringing that research to customers through intuitive tools for creating, testing, and shipping with voice.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Voices team. Every conversation powered by Cartesia starts with a voice. The Voices team builds how customers find, clone, and design voices that sound right for their product, in any language.

The work reaches across the company. You’ll work closely with:

* **Research**: Turn new model capabilities into product features, such as turning voices multilingual and steering voices to match the ideal profile.
* **Platform and infra**: Serve every voice reliably at the scale of our API traffic.
* **On-prem**: Build adaptable interfaces and systems so that voices are available and compatible in a variety of settings and hardware.
* **Customer-facing teams**: Help every customer get a great voice on their own.

---------------

* Build polished product experiences for finding, cloning, and designing voices, from the first listen to a voice running in production.
* Design the APIs developers build on, so every capability is as easy to use in code as it is in the product.
* Turn early research into features customers use every day, like voice cloning, localization, and voice design.
* Build the backend systems that train, store, and serve custom voices at scale, in the cloud and on-prem.
* Raise the quality bar for every voice we launch, with internal tools, automated evaluations, and analytics that show how voices sound and perform.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience building and operating customer-facing software in production, ideally at a high-growth startup, including owning systems that serve high traffic reliably. We care more about what you’ve shipped and kept running at scale than strict years of experience.

* Full-stack range and the ability to own a product surface across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and operational concerns.
* Fluent use of coding agents and a habit of keeping pace with the frontier.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, strong cross-functional partnership, and a sharp presence in product and design reviews.

**Nice-To-Haves**
-----------------

* Experience building developer tools, creative tools, playgrounds, or API-adjacent products.
* Experience building AI-powered products and translating model capabilities, limitations, and quality tradeoffs into understandable user experiences.

jobs.description:
**About This Role**
-------------------

We’re looking for a Forward-Deployed Engineer to solve technical problems for our customers and build the software they need to succeed with depthfirst. You’ll work directly with enterprise engineering and security teams to understand their needs and own delivery from initial discovery through production.

Your work will span building customer-facing features, developing integrations, and helping customers deploy and operate depthfirst in their environments. Depending on the problem, you might extend a product capability, build an API integration, debug an application issue, or work through a complex deployment constraint. You’ll implement solutions yourself and turn recurring customer needs into lasting improvements across our product and platform.

We welcome engineers with different strengths. You might be a backend or full-stack engineer who wants to work more closely with customers, or an infrastructure engineer with deep experience in cloud systems, Kubernetes, and networking. You don’t need to arrive with expertise in every area. We’re looking for engineers who take ownership, learn unfamiliar systems, and ship solutions.

**You’re excited about this role because you will…**
----------------------------------------------------

* Build and ship customer-facing features, APIs, and integrations that solve real customer problems.
* Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, identify technical blockers, and define practical solutions.
* Own delivery from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration.
* Help customers integrate, deploy, and operate depthfirst within their existing systems and technical constraints.
* Investigate problems across application code, integrations, and infrastructure, and implement fixes.
* Turn solutions developed for individual customers into reusable product capabilities, tooling, and automation.
* Communicate technical tradeoffs and progress clearly, keeping customer and internal teams aligned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* A strong engineering background in **at least one** of the following:

  + **Backend or full-stack software engineering:** experience designing, building, and shipping production applications, services, APIs, or integrations.
  + **Infrastructure or platform engineering:** deep hands-on experience deploying and debugging production systems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and networking, with experience developing software and tooling.
* Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or Java, and experience writing, testing, and maintaining production code.
* Ability to take an ambiguous problem, identify a useful solution, and carry it through to production.
* Strong debugging skills and a willingness to work across unfamiliar systems.
* Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with customers. Prior customer-facing experience is helpful but not required.
* Ownership, practical judgment, and the ability to move quickly while building reliable software.

**Bonus Points For**
--------------------

* Experience delivering customer-facing features or owning technical engagements with enterprise customers.
* Experience integrating software with enterprise APIs, authentication systems, and developer workflows.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, or enterprise deployment requirements.
* Experience with AI platforms, developer tools, or security products.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary with meaningful equity.
* Health, vision, and dental insurance.
* Office lunch and dinner when working from our San Francisco office.
* Direct impact on customer success and product direction.
* The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and security.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

We are a well-funded, early-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026.

Our team currently consists of 25 world-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting-edge multimodal research into scalable, real-world systems.

**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking a Software Engineer to lead the client-facing product for Glimpse. In this role, you will design and build the integration layer, including but not limited to API, web interfaces, and platform tools that external developers will use to interact with our multimodal models. You will also collaborate directly with research, infrastructure, and GTM teams to ensure smooth delivery of future model releases.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Craft the Front Door to AI:** Build, scale, and polish the Glimpse developer console, interactive model playgrounds, real-time analytics, and seamless onboarding flows.
* **Architect End-to-End Solutions:** Lead front-end development while bridging backend services with a focus on multimodal data handling, streamed responses, visual outputs, and other platform features such as API key management, budget page, and docs.
* **Drive Product & Visual Design:** You’re the designer — spearhead the UX design for interaction with multimodal input, creating sleek wireframes and high-craft UI that redefine how developers experience frontier AI.
* **Revolutionize Developer Workflows:** Engage directly with our developer community to invent frictionless experiences that make integrating Glimpse effortless.
* **Keep the Product Experience Healthy:** Build dashboards and tools to monitor product health and the endpoints it depends on. Be part of the first response when something customers rely on breaks.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* **Front-End Expertise & Full-Stack Versatility:** Exceptional skills in modern web tech stack (e.g. React, TypeScript, Go gateway, Python services) and user experience design, combined with full-stack fluency to build supporting API endpoints.
* **Performance & Security Sense:** You know how to keep a web app fast and safe. You’ve tracked down slow page loads or laggy interactions, and you handle sign-in, API keys, and user uploads with care.
* **Passionate Product Craftsman:** Proven track record of building developer-facing tools, dashboards, or self-serve platform experiences with strong taste and attention to interaction detail.
* **Core Foundations & Front-End Reliability:** Solid grounding in API contracts, product lifecycle, failure modes, billing correctness, observability, and reliability, alongside experience keeping web interfaces reliable through monitoring and rapid debugging.
* **Product and Design Ownership:** Comfortable owning a product surface end to end and making design decisions yourself, with good judgment about usability.
* **High Agency:** Comfortable with ambiguity in a small team, able to balance speed against quality.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* **Aesthetic Sense:** A strong eye for visual design, interaction detail, and craft. A portfolio or shipped product we can click through is optional but highly recommended.
* **Backend Reliability, Scaling & Distributed Systems:** Hands-on experience with distributed systems, backend reliability, scaling, and connecting internal systems to external products smoothly.
* **AI Product Experience:** Experience building products on top of AI or ML models.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - AWS OpenSearch, OpenSearch Platform Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon OpenSearch Service powers search, log analytics, observability, and vector workloads for tens of thousands of customers. Every one of those customers runs on software that our Data Plane Platform team ships, and keeping it current means updating and managing software updates across millions of instances at scale, safely and continuously. We own the release engine for the managed OpenSearch data plane: the pipelines, the automation, and the Release Rover platform that take an upstream open source cut all the way to GA across every supported version and region.  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us turn releasing OpenSearch from a hand-coordinated effort into a fully automated, self-service platform. The team has already sharply reduced release cycle time, increased release throughput, consolidated its pipelines, and driven per-engineer release effort close to zero. You will build pieces of that system: the tooling, orchestration, and AI-assisted automation that let teams release safely with less manual effort.  
  
This is a hands-on builder role at the intersection of distributed systems, CI/CD, and developer experience, with a strong and growing emphasis on AI. You will own well-scoped components end to end, from design through operations, with mentorship from senior engineers on the team, and you will have real opportunity to apply AI and agentic automation to real release problems. The code you ship becomes part of the paved road the OpenSearch organization releases on.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Build and operate the services, pipelines, and automation that update and manage software updates across millions of instances at scale, safely and continuously, across many versions and regions.  
Build and extend the self-service release platform so builders across the organization can ship features quickly and reliably.  
Improve release safety with staged rollouts, automated validation, rollback, and blast-radius controls so a bad change does not reach customers at scale.  
Apply AI and agentic automation to the parts of releasing that still require manual effort today.  
Own the operations of what you build: on-call, runbooks, metrics, and reducing operational load over time.  
Partner with the engineering teams who build and release on top of your platform.  
  
A day in the life  
You will split your time between building and operating the release platform. On the build side, you design and ship components that make releasing OpenSearch more automated and safer, and a large and growing part of that is applying AI and agentic automation to the parts of releasing that still take manual effort today. This is a team that treats AI as a core engineering tool, not an afterthought, so you will have real room to prototype, measure, and productionize AI-driven improvements to the release workflow. On the operational side, you keep active release trains healthy, support the teams releasing through the platform, and review changes with a focus on release safety. You will work closely with senior engineers who will help you grow your scope and design judgment over time.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.description:
**About Lumafield:**

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA.

**About the role:**

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer at Lumafield, you will own the cloud platform that runs Voyager, our CT data platform. A scan is only useful once someone can open it, measure it, and make a decision, and that happens in Voyager, in a web browser. Everything underneath is yours: AWS, the production Kubernetes clusters, Terraform, the pipeline every engineer ships through, observability, and the cloud side of our security and compliance programs.

This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. Nobody will hand you a backlog; you will be the person who knows what the platform needs, what it costs, and what to fix first. We expect you to grow into a senior engineer here.

You will work in Platform Engineering alongside the backend lead, the software engineers who ship through your pipeline every day, and the team building the on-prem version of Voyager for customers who cannot send scan data to the cloud. You will report to engineering leadership; Platform Engineering is part of the organization our new Head of Software will lead.

This is a hands-on, in-person role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

  

### **What you'll do:**

* Own our AWS accounts and regions: architecture, access, onboarding and offboarding, and a bill you can explain by service and environment, then bring down
* Run the production EKS clusters, and carry Kubernetes version upgrades from plan and rehearsal to completion, with a rollback ready
* Keep infrastructure and Kubernetes configuration in Terraform, so changes go through code review instead of the console
* Own CI/CD - GitHub Actions, CI runners, artifact and image storage, and GitOps deploys with ArgoCD - and make it faster and more reliable in ways engineers notice
* Own observability (Sentry, Logz.io and Postman today) and decide what the platform needs next; take on-call, and close every incident with a written postmortem and a fix
* Own the cloud side of our SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 programs: least-privilege access, logging, encryption, cluster hardening, and audit evidence that comes out of the system instead of being assembled by hand
* Partner with our IT team on shared controls, and raise the platform's security bar as we maintain CMMC Level 1 and ITAR compliance and work toward FedRAMP 20x
* Document the platform - runbooks, postmortems, and design notes - so it does not live in one person's head

### **About you:**

* You have been on the hook for a production platform: releases, incidents, and on-call
* You have upgraded a production Kubernetes cluster and can tell us what went wrong and what you changed afterwards
* You write Terraform that other people depend on, and you are comfortable with modules, state, and reading a plan before you apply it
* You have built or rebuilt a CI/CD pipeline that engineers used daily
* You have opened a cloud bill, found what was driving it, and changed it
* You have implemented a security control or produced audit evidence for a program such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, or done the equivalent access and hardening work without the audit
* You write clearly: runbooks, postmortems, and design notes someone else can act on
* Production experience on ECS rather than Kubernetes, or on GCP/GKE rather than AWS, still counts when your infrastructure-as-code work is strong; tell us how you would close the gap

### **Bonus:**

* Large-file or 3D data pipelines, or GPU workloads
* Software that talks to hardware in the field
* Regulated environments such as FedRAMP, ITAR, or CMMC

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Join AMD IT’s Compute Platforms Engineering team and help build the infrastructure powering high-performance computing, distributed AI training, and inference workloads. As an HPC & AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will work in a highly technical, hands-on environment supporting large-scale CPU and GPU compute platforms across on-premises and cloud environments.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, HPC, GPU computing, high-speed networking, storage, and cloud infrastructure. You will help bring new compute capabilities into production, improve the performance and reliability of existing platforms, and gain exposure to evolving technologies supporting increasingly complex AI and engineering workloads. You will collaborate with infrastructure architects, network and operations engineers, researchers, cloud providers, and hardware and technology partners to solve challenging systems problems and deliver scalable computing solutions.

jobs.description:
**Infrastructure Engineer**
---------------------------

**MSP4, LLC | Full-Time | Onsite (United States, posted location) | Up to 10% Regional Travel | 4 to 6 Years Experience | Reports To: Service Desk Manager, with technical escalation to the Senior Infrastructure Engineer**

### **About the Role**

MSP4 operates as the embedded IT department for a portfolio of clients spanning professional services, legal, distribution, manufacturing, and government sectors. Environments range from 50 to 1,500 users, with CMMC L2, NIST 800-171, and SOC 2 as active requirements.

This role keeps running environments running. You own the server and platform layer in steady state: the escalations that pass above the endpoint and site tier, the patching and monitoring and health work that stops incidents from happening, and the day-to-day administration of Windows Server, virtualization, storage, backup, and Microsoft cloud across your assigned clients.

You are the technical ceiling of the support organization. L2 escalations land with you and stop there unless the answer is a design change — at which point they go to the Senior Infrastructure Engineer who owns that domain. Knowing which is which, and saying so rather than guessing, is most of the job.

This is an onsite role at a client facility in your posted location, with regional coverage for nearby MSP4 clients. You are in the environment every day, and that presence is the reason the role exists.

**Infrastructure Engineer is a single tier with two specializations, Operations and Projects, sharing one compensation band and one core qualification set.** If build and migration work fits you better, say so on your cover page.

### **What You Will Do**

* Own L2 escalations at the server and platform layer: take what passes the endpoint and site tier, resolve it within scope, and escalate cleanly to the Senior Infrastructure Engineer when the fix is a design change rather than a repair
* Administer Windows Server environments day to day: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, PKI, certificate services, and file and print services
* Operate Hyper-V and VMware vSphere clusters: VM lifecycle, capacity monitoring, host patching, live migration, HA behavior, and snapshot hygiene
* Run storage and clustering operations: provisioning, volume changes, capacity monitoring, and health checks against failover clustering and Storage Spaces Direct or comparable SAN/HCI platforms. Storage architecture sits with Senior Infrastructure Engineering
* Operate Veeam Backup and Replication: job management, backup verification, restore execution, repository and retention operations, and backup gap remediation
* Administer Microsoft 365 and Azure tenants: identity, licensing, Intune policy application, and Conditional Access within established standards
* Perform SQL Server platform work supporting client ERP and line-of-business applications: patching, version upgrades, backup coordination with Veeam, and baseline instance administration. DBA-level query tuning, indexing strategy, and application-side schema work sit with client DBAs or application vendors
* Execute network change at defined scope: firewall rule adds and modifications against approved standards, VLAN configuration, and switch port and access layer work. Routing, firewall policy design, and segmentation architecture sit with Senior Network Security Engineering — the stop-and-escalate boundary is stated, not guessed
* Apply STIG hardening and NIST 800-171 control execution at the server and platform layer in support of CMMC L2 and SOC 2, and capture the evidence
* Run the proactive work: patching cadence, monitoring coverage, health checks, capacity review, and closing the gap between a well-designed environment and a well-run one
* Receive completed projects into managed operations: review the handover, confirm the runbooks work, and own the platform from that point forward
* Communicate with client technical contacts and non-technical stakeholders on infrastructure work, change windows, and incidents
* Maintain ticketing and change discipline in a PSA or ITSM platform (Jira Service Management preferred; HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, or ServiceNow transferable)

### **Growth Path**

This specialization is a full career position, not a waiting room. Engineers who want to move toward design ownership have two routes: across into the Projects specialization, which leads to senior domain ownership, or deeper into platform expertise within Operations. Both are supported, and movement between specializations does not require re-interviewing into the tier.

jobs.description:
**About Opplane**

Opplane helps organizations unlock the value of their data in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, connectivity, and regulation.

We work with businesses across complex, data-intensive industries to turn fragmented or difficult-to-use data into trusted, actionable intelligence. Our work spans connectivity technologies, AI and data solutions for banking and fintech, and data governance and modernization.

Our founders and leadership team bring decades of experience in networking, wireless and telecom, having built and scaled multiple technology companies, several of them acquired by leading networking and technology players. Drawing on years of selling networking infrastructure, we are involved in building critical infrastructure for telecom operators, developing carrier-grade, software-based solutions that help them deliver secure, scalable connectivity to their enterprise customers.

**Why this role matters**

Our connectivity solutions run in the networks of major telecom operators and the enterprises they serve. Deploying them well takes more than configuration. It takes someone who understands the client’s network, can explain clearly what our solution does, and earns the client’s trust along the way.

In this role, you’ll be the main technical contact for our clients during deployments: shaping how our products fit their environments, working through issues with them, and bringing what you learn back to our Product and Engineering teams. You’ll also be well placed to spot where else we can help.

**What you’ll do**

* Act as the main technical contact for clients, from design discussions through deployment and operation
* Work with clients to understand their networks and requirements, and shape how our solutions fit them
* Lead transport and routing work during deployments, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN and IPsec VPN
* Deploy and support our solutions on cloud platforms, including VNFs and CNFs on OpenStack and public clouds
* Automate deployments and operations with infrastructure as code (Python, Ansible, Terraform)
* Troubleshoot complex issues across network, cloud and Linux environments, and explain clearly what’s happening and what comes next
* Bring client insight back to Product and Engineering, and flag where Opplane could help furthe

**What you’ll bring**

Experience and expertise

* 5+ years as a network engineer, including client-facing work such as solution design, deployments or technical advisory
* Strong hands-on routing: deploying and troubleshooting BGP and OSPF, ideally in large, operator-scale environments
* Excellent knowledge of TCP/IP, VXLAN and L2/L3 VPN, and of WAN technologies such as SD-WAN and IPsec VPN
* A good understanding of 4G LTE and 5G core networks, including mobile private networks
* Experience with VNFs and CNFs and with cloud networking, including OpenStack (Heat templates)
* Infrastructure as code with Python, Ansible or Terraform, and Git
* Comfort troubleshooting in Linux-based environments
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or IT, or equivalent experience
* Fluent English, written and spoken

How you work

* You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical audiences, and connect them to what matters for the client
* You use good judgment about what to share with clients, and handle sensitive situations with honesty and discretion
* You notice client needs beyond the immediate project and raise them with the team
* You stay calm and constructive when a client is under pressure
* You’re comfortable being the client’s main contact, without a large team behind you
* You’re willing to travel to client sites

Nice to have

* Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies
* Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI
* SDN and distributed systems
* Overlay and tunnelling technologies
* CCNA/CCNP or Linux certifications
* Start-up experience

**What you’ll have the opportunity to do**

* Shape how our connectivity solutions are deployed in operator and enterprise networks
* Work across routing, mobile core, cloud and automation, not just one layer
* Influence the product directly, with your client insight feeding Product and Engineering

**How we work**

Small team, big challenges, real ownership. At Opplane, you’ll work on software and technology across data, AI and connectivity, helping build solutions that address complex technical and business needs. You’ll have access to leadership, opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and room to influence how we approach problems and build our products.

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with colleagues, clients and stakeholders across the US, Portugal, Singapore and India. Our work brings together different areas of expertise and perspectives, making it important to stay curious, exchange ideas and understand the challenges others are working to solve. We value people who take initiative, share their knowledge and bring new perspectives to the way we work.

Ultimately, it’s about bringing people and technology together to build solutions that meet today’s needs and anticipate tomorrow’s challenges.

**Interested?**

If this opportunity sounds like a good fit for your experience and the kind of work you want to do, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply to learn more about the role and how you could contribute to Opplane.

jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

When a robotics team trains on Mecka’s data, they need to trust what they’re getting. You’ll define what that trust rests on: the benchmarks, audits and quality standards behind every delivery. You’ll dig into the failures that averages hide, question results that look too good and make the call on whether data is ready to ship.

You’ll work across Computer Vision, annotation, operations and delivery. We’re looking for someone with a machine learning and data science background who enjoys getting to the bottom of a difficult measurement problem, and can turn what they find into a quality bar the whole team can use.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own the benchmark methodology: which evaluation sets exist, how they are sampled, which metrics apply and how versions are frozen and compared.
* Write customer quality specifications and audit rubrics, and keep both aligned with what customers actually reject.
* Run human audits and work with annotation and operations on sampling, agreement, throughput and cost.
* Build automated checks and graders that reduce manual review costs and are hard to game.
* Track where recorded hours are lost, report quality results regularly and make the ship or no-ship call on data.

### **What you need**

* Experience in evaluation, measurement or data quality for machine learning systems, or in data operations at scale.
* A machine learning and data science background, with strong Python and working knowledge of statistics: sampling, precision and recall, agreement and confidence intervals.
* Experience designing evaluation protocols and ground-truth pipelines from scratch.
* The judgment to challenge a research team’s numbers and support that challenge with evidence.
* An eye for how a metric can be gamed, and the habit of closing those gaps.

### **Nice to have**

* **Benchmarks and metrics:** 3D pose, trajectory and reconstruction metrics such as MPJPE and ATE.
* **Audits and data quality:** Sampling design, inter-annotator agreement, loss accounting and managing annotators or vendors.
* **Automated checks and graders:** Verifiers, learned scoring, active learning and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* **Data curation and scoring:** Quality scoring, filtering and composition of large datasets.

Manages new product introduction and production support engineering for a specific product or group of products from inception of ideas to in-house qualification to supporting at the customer. Participates in design, process, test, reliability and manufacturing engineering to solve product issues and production problems. Develops and sustains process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields.

  

Develops new or modified hardware designs for electrostatic chucks (ESC’s) and supporting hardware in Lam plasma etchers. ESC’s are a highly multidisciplinary technology and offers opportunity to innovate on the intersection of physics, materials, and software algorithms to provide our customers differentiated solutions. Reviews process and customer requirements to define engineering specifications for ESC’s and ESC subsystems. Understanding performance of this particular part of Lam plasma etchers requires a multidisciplinary background, incorporating elements of materials science, physics, mechanical and electrical engineering, to fully understand the implications of design changes on customer processing.

jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build models for the problems in front of us.** You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
* **Work through the difficult footage.** You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
* **Find out where your models fail.** You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
* **Own the path to production.** You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
* **Follow problems through to a fix.** You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Strong machine learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
* **Experience training large vision models from scratch.** Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
* **Depth in a computer vision specialty.** You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
* **Experience owning models in production.** You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
* **Comfort with the work as it is.** You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Hand and body tracking:** 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
* **SLAM, VIO and calibration:** Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
* **3D reconstruction and objects:** Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

jobs.description:

For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  
  
*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

**Position Summary:**

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Data Science Analyst/Engineer.
  
  
The Tan Lab at NYU is recruiting a Data Science Analyst/Engineer to develop and maintain computational infrastructure for machine learning in genomics. Our mission is to understand how elements of our genome regulate gene expression and its implications for human diseases. We combine machine learning, biological mechanisms, and large-scale data to understand how regulatory elements control transcription factors, 3D genome organization, and transcription. This position will maintain the lab's data and ML infrastructure, including processing, organizing, and managing terabyte-scale datasets; designing robust bioinformatics pipelines; and optimizing ML training pipelines and model architectures to accelerate and scale genomics research in the lab.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and present results, reports, both oral and written, to a variety of audiences, concerning processes, models, evaluation, and impact
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Independently design, execute, and communicate computational research projects in machine learning and functional genomics that advance the labs research mission.

  

**Additional Position Specific Responsibilities:**  

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot end-to-end bioinformatics infrastructure for sequencing data processing using workflow-management systems such as Nextflow, Snakemake, or WDL.
* Develop and validate pipelines for assays such as RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, CUT&RUN/CUT&Tag, Hi-C, Micro-C, single-cell sequencing, and related emerging technologies.
* Containerize computational environments using Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, Conda, or related technologies.
* Develop new bioinformatics pipelines and work with wet-lab people to support new molecular assays or improve processing of current assays.
* Perform quality analysis of the generated sequencing data and develop solutions to enhance future performance.
* Develop distributed and mixed-precision training workflows for multi-GPU and multi-node environments.
* Manage our compute space on HPC and cloud providers such as AWS and Google Cloud. Monitor storage and compute costs.
* Profile and optimize model training, inference, memory use, data loading, and communication overhead.

* Design and maintain biological and real-world evaluation frameworks by collaborating with domain experts within and outside of the lab.
* Maintain internal and open-source software repositories, technical documentation, and onboarding materials.

Machine Learning, Applied Stascs, Mathematics or similar field) and 3 years of  
experience in machine learning/ data science.  
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, R) and machine learning tools  
(scikitlearn, R)
